headline: Turkish Residential Property Sales Fall 23.3% in October
summary: Home sales in Turkey fell 23.3% year-on-year in October to 131,000 units, while purchases by foreign buyers registered a slight 0.9% increase, according to official statistical agency data.
why: Turkey's residential property sector is a major component of domestic investment and employment, currently facing tight monetary policy and elevated mortgage rates.

impacts.name: Turkey Real Estate
impacts.why: High borrowing rates continue to depress mortgage demand and overall domestic home transaction volumes.
